scenes: Can dry ground make a heatwave worse?
Moist soil cools the air as its water evaporates. | When the soil dries out, that cooling stops, | so the air heats faster, and dries the soil further.
Keeping water in the ground keeps the cooling in: | ponds, mulch, trees and wetlands.
